title: cy6c.1: Analyze ESP32-S3 ELF memory map vs Renode .repl platform
description: Read the ESP32-S3 ELF program headers (readelf -l) for Heltec V3 and T-Deck builds. Cross-reference against the current Renode .repl platform description. Document which address ranges are unmapped (causing the load failure). The ESP32-S3 TRM has the canonical memory map. Pure analysis — no hardware needed.
